title: Railway Ministry reiterates bedroll kit directive for RAC passengers after repeated complaints
summary: the Railway Board's instructions must be strictly followed to ensure that every RAC passenger travelling in AC coaches (except AC Chair Car) is provided with a complete bedroll kit at par with other bona fide passengers travelling in the coach, says the Ministry in a letter dated August 4.

title: Amarnath Yatra suspended from Jammu amid tight security on Article 370 abrogation anniversary

title: Watch: Why BJP may have to rethink its delimitation plans
summary: For years, the BJP has worked on the assumption that it had built a durable Hindu voting coalition across much of the Hindi heartland. Not that all Hindus vote for the party, but enough do, across caste groups, to give it a structural edge.  But two recent developments raise questions about that logic: Bankipur and Jantar Mantar.
